features.name: Personalized home product feed and merchandising content
steps: The user enters the Taobao home page
A mix of product recommendations, "recommended for you", campaign slots, and brand/channel entries
Each module's structure is presented correctly
Modules do not cross positions
features.expected: The home page must present product recommendations, campaign slots, and brand/channel entries in a mixed structure; each module's content is distinguishable and does not cross positions; scrolling loads without duplication or loss.

features.name: Multi-level product category Mega Menu navigation
steps: Hover/click a first-level category
Expand the advanced settings
Switching between different first-level categories changes the content dynamically
Tapping a specific category enters the correct product set
features.expected: Hovering/clicking a first-level category must expand the corresponding second- and third-level categories; when switching categories the content is correctly replaced; clicking a specific category enters the corresponding product set with the correct filter conditions.

features.name: Global product search and query context
steps: Enter keywords
Search
Get the product results
Adjust the query / enter the product
The original search keyword and context are still preserved after returning
features.expected: The search results must match the keyword; after adjusting the query the results change in sync; after entering a product and returning, the original search keyword and result state must be preserved.

features.name: Image-search chain
steps: From the camera entry in the search bar or "find similar by image" on a product
Upload/select an image

Show the readable fields such as the real file path, size, audio format, bitrate, sample rate, added/modified time, Track/Disc, Title, Artist, Album, Album Artist, Genre, Year, Duration, and ReplayGain
Tap the result
The visual-query context is preserved after returning
features.expected: The camera entry / find-similar-by-image must upload/select an image; similar-product results are shown (preset mappings); after tapping a result and returning, the visual-query context is preserved.

features.name: All-channel and vertical-business entry orchestration
steps: Open "all channels"
Browse vertical channels such as Tmall, live, enterprise procurement, judicial auction, supermarket, subsidy, and discounts
Tapping enters the corresponding business space
features.expected: "All channels" must show the entries of each vertical channel; tapping enters the corresponding business space; after returning the channel-list state is preserved; the entries must not point to the wrong space.

features.name: Automatic browsing-footprint recording and time-based aggregation
steps: Browse products A/B
The product automatically enters "My footprints"
Group by date
Visit again to update the behavior
Footprints can be searched/batch-deleted
features.expected: Browsed products must automatically enter "My footprints"; date grouping is correct; revisiting updates the time and grouping; the list changes in sync after search/batch delete.

features.name: Purchase-shop history aggregation
steps: After completing a transaction the shop must automatically appear under "shops purchased from"; category aggregation is correct; the shop can be re-entered; the shop information matches the transaction records.
"Shops purchased from" is formed automatically
Aggregate by category such as digital/food/home
You can re-enter the shop or contact customer service
features.expected: After completing, the completion time is recorded and the task is hidden, kept, or moved to the bottom according to the list settings; un-completing restores the normal state; after deletion the main list, tags, places, and list counts update in sync; clearing completed only deletes completed tasks in the current scope.

features.name: Extend receipt or confirm receipt
steps: Follow the shop in the shop/purchase records
Enter "followed shops"
View by state such as recently followed / specially followed / has new items
Cancelling or adjusting the follow syncs
features.expected: After following, the shop appears under "followed shops"; the results in each state group (recent / specially followed / has new items) are correct; after unfollowing it is removed in sync; the state must persist.

features.name: Product favorites and cross-page state sync
steps: Favorite a product on the product page
"Favorite items" appears
The favorite button stays active
Unfavorite from the favorites page
Returning to the product page restores the state in sync
features.expected: After favoriting, the button stays active and the product appears in "favorite items"; after unfavoriting from the favorites page the product page state syncs back; the two states must always be consistent.

features.name: Multi-dimensional management of favorited products and product-state awareness
steps: Enter favorites
Filter by price drop / category / product state / favorite time / sort
The tags change after a product becomes unavailable or its price drops
Batch operations still respect the filter logic
features.expected: Each dimension's filters (price drop / category / state / time) must correctly apply to the favorites collection; after a product's price drops or it becomes unavailable the tags change in sync; the filter logic is preserved after batch operations.

features.name: Adding cart products and preserving the SKU context
steps: Select the product's color/size/specification
Add to cart
The cart shows the correct SKU, price, shop, and quantity
Re-entering keeps the same specification
features.expected: The cart entry's SKU (color/size), price, shop, and quantity must match the selection; re-entering the same product keeps the selected specification; after changing the specification the entry updates in sync.

features.name: Cart grouping by shop and multi-select checkout
steps: Products from several shops enter the cart
Group by shop
Single select / select all in a shop / select all
The checkout area only counts the currently selected products
features.expected: The cart must be correctly grouped by shop; the selection states for single select / select all in a shop / select all link correctly; the checkout amount only counts the currently selected products.

features.name: The cart count, specification, stock, and price are linked
steps: Change the quantity or re-select the specification
Validate the stock/product state
The unit price and total are recomputed
An invalid specification blocks normal checkout
features.expected: After changing the quantity or specification the unit price and total must be recomputed; stock/product-state validation takes effect; an invalid specification must block checkout and give a notice.

features.name: Batch cart operations and favorites migration
steps: Select one or more cart products
Delete / move to favorites
The cart count, favorites list, and top cart badge change in sync
features.expected: After deleting/moving to favorites the cart list, favorites list, and top badge must change in sync; batch operations only affect the selected items; product data is not lost after the migration.

features.name: Cart checkout details and dynamic amount computation
steps: The user selects several products
The quantity/specification/promotion conditions change
The checkout details on the right are recomputed in real time
Unselected products do not count toward the amount
features.expected: The checkout details must be recomputed in real time with quantity/specification/promotion changes; unselected products do not count toward the amount; the detail amount stays consistent with the cart's selected items.

features.name: Shipping address book and default-address policy
steps: Add several addresses
Edit the address
Set default / pin
Delete or cancel the default
Subsequent purchases use the correct default address
features.expected: After adding/editing an address the list updates in sync; the default and pinned policies take effect correctly; after deleting or cancelling the default, subsequent purchases use the correct default address.

features.name: The transaction loop from cart checkout to order creation
steps: Selecting products in the cart
Tap checkout
Choose the address / confirm the products and amount
Submit the order
Generate an order
The corresponding cart products are removed
The new order appears in the order center
features.expected: After submitting the order a new order must be generated; the corresponding products are removed from the cart in sync; the order appears in the order center; the order amount matches the amount confirmed on the checkout page.

features.name: Order state machine and state-category views
steps: Order generation
Pending payment
To be shipped
To be received
To be reviewed/completed
Each stage automatically enters the corresponding tab and determines the allowed operations
features.expected: Each state's orders must automatically enter the corresponding tabs; the state flow determines the available operations; after an operation the state and tab membership change in sync; a completed state must not be reverted by a wrong operation.

features.name: Order search, filtering, pagination, and export
steps: Query in the order center by product/order number/shop/courier, etc.
Combined filtering
Pagination
The corresponding tag and task count appear in the tags area of the navigation drawer
The current query conditions correctly apply to the results
features.expected: The query conditions must correctly apply to the results; combined filters intersect; paginated data is neither duplicated nor lost; the exported file content matches the current query results.

features.name: Logistics tracking and receipt confirmation
steps: The same start and end points already exist
View the logistics (preset track)
Order-status rendering
Build a play queue with at least three songs
The order state and available actions change in sync
features.expected: The logistics track (preset) must be presented correctly; after extending or confirming receipt the order state and available actions change in sync; the operation results must persist.

features.name: Re-purchase after an order and products flowing back into the cart
steps: Tap "buy again" / "add to cart" from a past order
Rebuild the purchase context using the original product information
Appropriate degradation when a product becomes unavailable
features.expected: "Buy again" must rebuild the purchase context using the original product information; degradation is clear when the product is unavailable; after adding to the cart the item information is correct.

features.name: Post-purchase reviews and review-state management
steps: The elapsed time keeps increasing
Enter pending review
Submit the review
The pending-review count decreases
The record can be found in review management
Duplicate valid reviews are not allowed
features.expected: After submitting a review the pending-review count decreases; the review record appears in review management; repeated valid reviews for the same order are not allowed; the review content must persist.

features.name: Refund/after-sales workflow (user side)
steps: Request a refund from an order
Choose the service type
Create an after-sales ticket
State transitions (preset handling results)
Success/failure/cancel
The refund amount and order state sync correctly
features.expected: After creating an after-sales ticket the state follows the preset flow; the refund amount and order state sync correctly; the success/failure/cancel branches have clear states.

features.name: Multi-condition after-sales record queries and platform-intervention state
steps: Refund management
Filter by combinations such as refund type, time, refund state, advance-payment state, and platform intervention
Open the service details
The original query is preserved on return
features.expected: The combined conditions correctly filter the after-sales records; state fields such as platform intervention are correctly displayed; the original query conditions are preserved after opening the details and returning.

features.name: Complaint/rights-protection workflow (user side)
steps: File a complaint about an order/merchant
Choose the complaint reason
Generate a complaint ticket
State transitions (preset handling results)
Complaint upheld/rejected
The details and history are viewable
features.expected: After filing a complaint a complaint ticket is generated and the state follows the preset flow; the upheld/rejected results are correctly reflected; the history is viewable and consistent.

features.name: E-invoice requests and order linkage
steps: The divider remains effective after panning; both sides' views share the same coordinates.
Request an invoice
Fill in/choose the invoice title
Invoice-status transitions (preset)
View/download the invoice file
The invoice is always linked to the correct order
features.expected: After the request the invoicing state follows the preset flow; the invoice file can be viewed/downloaded; the invoice is always linked to the correct order; order-invoice mismatches must not occur.

features.name: Merchant customer-service session system
steps: Contact customer service from an order/shop
Open the corresponding merchant session (preset contacts)
Send a text/image message
The unread count updates
After switching contacts each session's context is isolated
features.expected: Tapping customer service must open the corresponding merchant's session (preset contacts); after sending a message it is correctly displayed in the session; the unread count updates in sync; after switching contacts each session's context is isolated.

features.name: Message center linked with the global unread badge
steps: Preset messages (merchant/logistics/service)
The top and sidebar badges update
Open a message
The countdown starts at the set time
The unread count decreases after reading
features.expected: The preset messages must make the top/sidebar badges show unread; opening a message locates the correct business object; the unread count decreases in sync after reading; the counts stay consistent everywhere.

features.name: Personal profile and transaction configuration
steps: Edit personal information such as the avatar/nickname
Edit transaction configurations such as shipping addresses
Subsequent screens read the latest configuration
features.expected: After modifying the profile/configuration it saves successfully; subsequent screens (orders/address selection) read the latest configuration; the modification must persist and stay after a refresh.

features.name: Consistent propagation of global behavior/transaction events
steps: Actions such as favoriting, adding to cart, purchasing, refunding, following, and browsing occur
Affected areas such as badges, favorites, the cart, orders, footprints, and shop relationships stay consistent
features.expected: After actions such as favoriting / adding to cart / purchasing / refunding / following / browsing occur, the affected areas (badges, favorites, cart, orders, footprints, shop relationships) must stay consistent; single-point update omissions must not occur.

exclusions.feature:
Personalized recommendation engine
"Recommended for you" ranking and user-profile-driven recommendations
exclusions.reason: Requires a recommendation model and behavior data (cf. Spotify "Recommendation / personalization engine"); the feed structure can use preset fixtures

exclusions.feature:
Real payment and transaction settlement
Payment gateways, fund flows, and real transactions
exclusions.reason: Depends on the payment system; after localizing the order flow only the user-visible state is verified

exclusions.feature:
Merchant/platform handling flows
Shipping, refund review, complaint arbitration, and invoicing
exclusions.reason: User-side requests and state display are testable; the handling results are driven by preset fixtures; retained surface: f18 order state machine and state-category views, f23 refund/after-sales workflow (user side), f25 complaint/rights-protection workflow (user side)

exclusions.feature:
Real-time logistics data
Real courier tracks and delivery states
exclusions.reason: The logistics track is presented with fixed fixtures; no real courier API is used

exclusions.feature:
Real product and merchant data
Real product catalogs, prices, stock, and shop ratings
exclusions.reason: Use synthetic product fixtures (cf. Spotify "Real catalog"); real platform data is not required

exclusions.feature: Inventory and promotion conditions can use preset rules; the linkage logic is tested, not the platform engine
exclusions.reason: The app rebuilds its internal song database

exclusions.feature:
Image-similarity search algorithms
Visual similarity computation and ranking
exclusions.reason: The upload→result chain is testable; similar results use preset mappings (the CV model is not evaluated); retained surface: f04 image-search chain

exclusions.feature:
Print
Physical printers and the browser print dialog
exclusions.reason: Substitute export (file/PDF) (cf. the diagrams.net "Print to Physical Printer" exclusion)

exclusions.feature:
Account security and payment binding
Passwords, phone numbers, and Alipay binding
exclusions.reason: Accounts and payment identity belong to external systems (cf. Spotify "Account / Authentication complexity"); personal profile editing is kept; retained surface: f29 personal profile and transaction configuration

exclusions.feature:
Live-channel content
Live lists, streaming, and live-room interactions
Width and height can be edited independently
exclusions.reason: Session UI/unread/switching are testable (preset contacts); real-time merchant-side responses are not verified; retained surface: f27 merchant customer-service session system

exclusions.feature:
The real event source of messages
Real generation of merchant/logistics/service messages
exclusions.reason: The message-center state machine is testable and requires preset message fixtures; retained surface: f18 order state machine and state-category views, f28 message center linked with the global unread badge
